exposure: First-trimester maternal serum screening markers (pregnancy-associated plasma protein-A (PAPP-A), free beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-hCG))
Hematological indices (mean platelet volume (MPV), hemoglobin concentration, white blood cell count, neutrophil count, lymphocyte count, platelet count, red cell distribution width)
outcome: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) (including placenta accreta, increta, and percreta)
cohort: The study included 181 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with placenta previa who had undergone first-trimester aneuploidy screening and delivered at the same tertiary care institution.
finding: Elevated first-trimester levels of PAPP-A and beta-hCG, along with a reduced mean platelet volume, may serve as early indicators for placenta accreta spectrum in pregnancies complicated by placenta previa.
